s1.title: A place to remember, in the heart of town
s1.intro: Honoring the service and sacrifice of all our nation's past, present and future military members — with special emphasis on the veterans who call Cambria home.

s2.heading: Dedicated Memorial Day, 2011
s2.text:
The Cambria Veterans Memorial was dedicated on Memorial Day, May 30, 2011. The Flag Memorial stands in the parking lot of the Veterans Memorial Hall at 1000 Main Street, where its flags fly over our town day and night.

The memorial was designed to recognize everyone who has served, and to reflect the character and charm of our community. Each Memorial Day, Post 432 gathers here to honor those who gave their lives in service and to remember our Post Everlasting.
s2.photo_alt: The Flag Memorial in daylight, with flags of the service branches around the American flag.
s2.photo_2_alt: Engraved memorial bricks with names, branches and years of service.

s3.heading: Secure your place in Cambria's history
s3.text: For a donation of $125 per brick, you can honor a veteran, a family or a loved one with an engraved brick on the Post's flag monument. You don't have to be a veteran to order one — any individual, business or organization is welcome.
s3.text_2:
1. Fill out the order formUse “Print my order form” above, or the blank PDF. You can order up to three bricks per form.
  2. Write your check$125 per brick, payable to “American Legion Post 432.”
  3. Mail both toPaver Project, American Legion Post 432, P.O. Box 697, Cambria, CA 93428-0697
s3.text_3: Your contribution may be tax-deductible; please consult your tax advisor. American Legion Post 432 reserves the right to decline brick inscriptions that do not reflect the spirit of the memorial. Questions? Call (805) 927-5010 or send us a message.
